references.text: David speaks of speaking in riddles, which can be seen as parallel to Jesus' use of parables.
Isaiah is told to make the people's heart fat, their ears heavy, and shut their eyes, which relates to why Jesus uses parables.
Habakkuk speaks of a vision that is like a riddle, similar to the use of parables to convey spiritual truths.
Jesus explains that he uses parables to fulfill the prophecy saying he will speak in parables.
Luke gives an account similar to Matthew's on why Jesus uses parables: to hide and reveal truths.
Paul quotes the prophet Isaiah about hearing without understanding and seeing without perceiving, which is relevant to the discussion of parables.
